INGREDIENTS:

  • 1 cup Eggnog
  • 1/2 teaspoon Ground Nutmeg
  • Good Feels Beverage Enhancer (add two .75ml droppers per serving, 4.5-5mg THC & 3mg CBD)
  • Cinnamon Sticks for garnish (optional)

INSTRUCTIONS:

  1. In a glass, pour the Eggnog
  2. Add the Good Feels Beverage Enhancer and stir well
  3. Sprinkle Ground Nutmeg on top
  4. Optionally, garnish with a cinnamon stick

INGREDIENTS:

  • 1 cup water
  • 1 lavender tea bag
  • 1-2 droppers of Good Feels Sleep Beverage Enhancer (adjust to preference)
  • Honey or sweetener (optional, to taste)
  • Cinnamon stick (for stirring)

INSTRUCTIONS:

  1. Boil 1 cup of water
  2. Steep the lavender tea bag in hot water for 5-7 minutes, infusing the flavors of the holiday season
  3. Remove the tea bag
  4. Allow the tea to cool to a warm, comfortable temperature
  5. Add 1-2 droppers of Good Feels Beverage Enhancer to the spiced tea. Adjust the dosage according to your preference
  6. Optionally, sweeten the tea with honey or your preferred sweetener to taste
  7. Stir well using a cinnamon stick

INGREDIENTS:

  • 1 cup of oat milk (or milk)
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1/4 cup maple syrup (adjust to taste)
  • 1/4 cup hot cocoa mix
  • Whipped Cream
  • Crushed candy canes for garnish
  • Good Feels Sleep Beverage Enhancer (Add two .75ml droppers per serving, 4.5-5mg THC & 3mg CBD, adjust to preference)

INSTRUCTIONS:

  1. In a saucepan, heat oat milk (milk) over medium heat until hot but not boiling
  2. Stir in vanilla extract, maple syrup, and hot cocoa mix. Continue to heat and whisk until well combined and hot
  3. Remove from heat and let it cool slightly
  4. Good Feels Sleep Beverage Enhancer (Add two .75ml droppers per serving, 4.5-5mg THC & 3mg CBD, adjust to preference) and stir well
  5. Pour the hot cocoa into a mug
  6. Top with whipped cream and crushed candy canes for a festive touch
  7. Enjoy Buddy the Elf’s Winter Delight!
